memories.text: User prefers answers in British English spelling.
User works at a logistics company, mainly on the routing service.
User's team standardised on Postgres 15 for all new services.
User's team migrated off Postgres 15 to Postgres 17 after the routing incident.
User does not want code comments unless the logic is genuinely non-obvious.
User asked once about the best sandwich shop near Liverpool Street.
User decided against introducing Kafka; the team uses Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY for the event fan-out.
User is allergic to shellfish.
The routing service has a hard requirement that p99 latency stays under 120ms.
User dislikes being given three options and asked to choose; they want one recommendation with the reasoning.
User previously used MongoDB at a former employer and found the migration painful.
The routing service's read replicas are in eu-west-2 and the primary is in eu-west-1.
User's manager is Priya; weekly one-to-one on Thursdays.
User prefers uv over pip and will not merge a PR that adds a requirements.txt.
User's laptop is a 16GB M2 MacBook Air; local Docker builds are slow.
The team's connection pooling is PgBouncer in transaction mode, which rules out session-level advisory locks.
User is learning Portuguese ahead of a move to Lisbon next year.
The routing service's nightly batch job runs at 02:00 UTC and saturates the primary's connection pool.
User's first language is English and they are comfortable with dense technical writing.
User asked to stop being reminded about the Kafka decision; it is settled.

turns.text: Our Postgres primary keeps saturating the connection pool right after the nightly batch. What should I change first?
Draft a short note to my manager about the latency work this week.
Where should we go for lunch on Thursday?
